content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ אַדִּיר וְנוֹרָא, אֱלֹהֵי עוֹלָם?
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha addir venora, elohē ‘olam?
content.english: Who is like You, Noble and awesome, eternal God?

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ הַמַּגִּיד מֵרֵאשִׁית אַחֲרִית, וּמְגַלֶּה מִקֶּֽדֶם כָּל־נֶעְלָם?
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha hammaggid mereshit aḥarit, umḡallē miḳḳedem kol ne‘lam?
content.english: Who is like You, Who foretells the end at the beginning, and reveals the unknown from the start?

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ רֹאשׁ דְּבָרְךָ אֱמֶת, בְּפִי כָל־הַיְצוּר כֻּלָּם.
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha rosh devarekha emet, befi khol haytsur kullam.
content.english: Who is like You? The beginning of Your word is truth, in the mouth of every single creature.

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ נֶאֶמְנוּ עֵדֶֽיךָ, הֵעַֽדְתָּ לִבְנֵי חָלַם וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם.
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha ne’emnu ‘edekha, he‘adta livnē ḥalam vehinnē sullam.
content.english: Who is like You? Your witnesses are faithful, whom You had testify for the children of the one who dreamed of a ladder.

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ בְּסַהֲדוֹ עַתָּה מִקֶּֽדֶם הִמְשִׁילָם.
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha besahado ‘atta miḳḳedem himshilam.
content.english: Who is like You? In His call to testimony now, [He called the ones to whom] He had compared [the Israelites] long ago.

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ נֶאְדַּֽרְתָּ בְמַעֲשֶֹֽיךָ, בִּפְרָטָם וּבִכְלָלָם.
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha ne’darta vema‘asekha, bifratam uvikhlalam.
content.english: Who is like You? You are ennobled by Your deeds, in their specifics and in general.

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ יִעֵד עֵדִים נֶאֱמָנִים, בְּלִי נִשְׁמָע קוֹלָם.
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha yi‘ed ‘edim ne’emanim, beli nishma‘ ḳolam.
content.english: Who is like You? He designated faithful witnesses, their voice inaudible.

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ וְאֶֽרֶץ נָתְנָה יְבוּלָהּ, וְהַשָּׁמַֽיִם יִתְּנוּ טַלָּם.
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha ve’erets natena yevulah vehash’shamayim yittenu tallam.
content.english: Who is like You? The land gives forth its produce, and heaven gives forth its dew.

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ סִבַּֽבְתָּ אוֹתוֹתֶֽיךָ עַל־פְּנֵי תֵבֵל לְפָעֳלָם.
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha sibbavta ototekha ‘al penē tevel lefa‘olam.
content.english: Who is like You? You made Your wonders come about, on the face of the earth, to put them into effect.

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ פֹּדֶה עַמְּךָ, וּמִבֵּית עֲבָדִים גְּאָלָם.
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha podē ‘ammekha, umibbet ‘avadim ge’alam.
content.english: Who is like You? Deliverer of Your people, who redeemed them from the house of bondage.

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ בְּאֶֽרֶץ מִדְבָּר פִּנִּֽיתָ מַסְלוּלָם.
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha be’erets midbar pinnita maslulam.
content.english: Who is like You? In the wilderness land, You cleared their path.

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ וּבְתֹֽהוּ יְלֵל יְשִׁימוֹן הָיָה שִׁמְשָׁם וְצִלָּם.
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha uvtohu yelel yehsimon haya shimsham vetsillam.
content.english: Who is like You? In the howling waste of the desert, He was their sun and their shade.

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ יָדַע מַה יַּעֲשֹוּ בְּמַעְבָּדָם וּבְמִפְעָלָם.
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha yada‘ ma ya‘asu bema‘bdam uvmif‘alam.
content.english: Who is like You? He knew what they would do in their actions and deeds.

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ מְפַזֵּר בְּאַרְבַּע פֵּאוֹת חֵילָם.
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha mefazzer be’arba‘ pe’ot ḥelam.
content.english: Who is like You? He dispersed their legions to the four corners [of the earth].

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ יִרְאֶה עָנְיָם לְעֵת תָּמוּט רַגְלָם.
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha yir’ē onyam le‘et tamut raḡlam.
content.english: Who is like You? He sees their affliction when their leg falters.

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ יַרְנִֽינוּ גוֹיִם עַמּוֹ, וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְמוּלָם.
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha yarninu ḡoyim ‘ammo, veyishtaḥavu lemulam.
content.english: Who is like You? Nations will gladden His people, and prostrate themselves to them.

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ אֹמֵר וְגֹמֵר בִּכְלָלָם?
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha omer veḡomer bikhlalam?
content.english: Who is like You, Who speaks and decrees definitively?

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ חוֹתָמְךָ נִכָּר, וְאַתָּה גֹּאֲלָם?
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha ḥotamekha nikkar, ve’atta go’alam?
content.english: Who is like You, You whose seal is recognizable, and You are their redeemer?

content.hebrew: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ יֹאמְרוּ בְשִׁיר הִלּוּלָם:
content.transliteration: Mi khamokha yomeru veshir hillulam:
content.english: Who is like You? They say in their song of praise:

content.hebrew: קהל: מִי כָמֽוֹךָ אֲשֶׁר מִיַּד צָר גְּאָלָם?
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Mi khamokha asher miyyad tsar ge’alam.
content.english: Cong. Who is like You, Who redeemed them from the foe’s hand?

content.hebrew: חזן: יֹ֭אמְר֖וּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יו֑י אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗ם מִיַּד־צָֽר:
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Yomeru ge’ulē Adonai asher ge’alam miyyad tsar:
content.english: Cantor: Let those redeemed by Adonai say that He has redeemed them from the enemy’s hand. (Ps. 107:2)

content.hebrew: קהל: גֹּֽאֲלֵ֕נוּ יו֥י צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ קְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְֹרָאֵֽל:
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Go’alenu Adonai tseva’ot ḳedosh Yisra’el:
content.english: Congregation: Our redeemer, Adonai Ẓeva’oth is His name, the Holy One of Israel. (Isa. 47:4)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “the Lord of Hosts.”
